name: tpl-not-co-existence-2-nogoal
task: Never both drop the key while the door is still closed and open the door.

value.feedback: CHANGES REQUIRED: NotCoExistence(key_lost, door_open) matches the task: it forbids the two events from both occurring during the episode, in either order. But the task also commands opening the door, and no clause requires door_open. Add hard Existence(door_open); the rule-only machine otherwise has no hard goal.

CHANGES REQUIRED: hard Existence(door_open) adds a requirement the task does not state. The task only forbids the key-lost event and door_open from both occurring; it does not command opening the door. Remove Existence(door_open) and keep the hard NotCoExistence(key_lost, door_open).
NO CHANGES NEEDED: hard NotCoExistence(key_lost, door_open) matches the task’s ban on dropping the key while the door is closed and opening the door during the same episode.

texts: The key-lost event and opening the door must not both occur during the episode.
machine:
REWARD_MACHINE:
STATES: u0, u1, u2, u3
INITIAL_STATE: u0
FINAL_STATES:
REJECTING_STATES: u3
DEFAULT_REWARD: 0

(u0, !door_open&key_lost) -> u1
(u0, door_open&!key_lost) -> u2
(u0, door_open&key_lost) -> u3
(u1, door_open) -> u3
(u2, key_lost) -> u3
REWARD_FUNCTION:

(u1, door_open, u3) -> -10
(u2, key_lost, u3) -> -10
